name: Rules-distill sweep with a script-first veto and a context budget
description: Scan the skill corpus for cross-cutting principles and distil them into rules, so a lesson learned inside one skill becomes available everywhere. Two mechanisms stop this from becoming rule bloat. The SCRIPT-FIRST VETO: a principle a script can enforce becomes a script, not a rule, because a rule competes for the always-on context budget while a script does not. And a hard BUDGET gate: the always-on rule surface has a line ceiling, and a proposal that would exceed it must displace something rather than accumulate. A caveat unique to one skill is never promoted - single-skill detail belongs in that skill.

skill_corpus.description: Roots of the skill vault to scan. One fan-out shard per root.

existing_rules.description: The current rules tree, so a proposal can be deduped against what already exists.

min_skills_for_promotion.description: A caveat must appear in at least this many skills to be cross-cutting. Below it, the detail belongs in its skill.

rule_line_budget.description: Ceiling on the always-on rule surface. The stated discipline is CLAUDE.md under 300 lines.

seeded_from_branch_capture.description: True when invoked as a subworkflow by the pre-PR capture, which supplies a candidate principle to test against the corpus.

corpus-scanner.description: Scans one corpus shard for repeated caveats and records where each occurrence lives.

cluster-synthesiser.description: Clusters occurrences into candidate principles. This is the subjective step and is labelled as such.

script-first-auditor.description: Holds the veto that turns an enforceable principle into a SCRIPT rather than a rule.

dedupe-auditor.description: Refutes a proposal that restates an existing rule, and distinguishes 'new rule' from 'existing rule needs updating'.

routes.reason: the synthesiser that clustered a principle will not see that it already exists as a rule
scanning is bounded pattern work; the judgement is in the clustering

stages.title: S0 - scan the corpus for repeated caveats

work_unit.title: Extract every caveat, gotcha and warning from one corpus shard with its location
work_unit.question_or_target: Record each caveat verbatim with the skill and file:line it came from, so a later cluster can count HOW MANY DISTINCT SKILLS exhibit it rather than how many times it was written.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: recognising a caveat that is phrased differently in two skills is judgement a grep cannot do

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each caveat with its verbatim text, its owning SKILL id, and a file:line anchor
tests_required: a caveat repeated twice inside ONE skill counts as one skill, not two occurrences - the promotion threshold is per-skill
a caveat phrased differently in two skills is recorded as two occurrences of one candidate, not two candidates
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the cluster-synthesiser, which needs per-skill attribution to count correctly
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8301 emitted only when every caveat carries a skill id and a file:line anchor; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8301 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then narrow the shard rather than re-scanning the same tree
work_unit.mechanism: per-skill caveat extraction with skill-level attribution for the promotion count

stages.title: S1 - cluster occurrences into candidate principles

work_unit.title: Cluster caveats into principles and count the DISTINCT skills exhibiting each
work_unit.question_or_target: Group semantically equivalent caveats into candidate principles, and for each record the distinct skills that exhibit it, so the promotion threshold is a count rather than an impression.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: clustering is the subjective step and is labelled subjective in the artifact rather than presented as measurement

work_unit.evidence_requirement: each candidate names the distinct skills exhibiting it with an anchor per skill, and the clustering is marked NON-DETERMINISTIC because it is model judgement
tests_required: a caveat present in 5 skills is surfaced as a candidate
a caveat unique to ONE skill is NOT promoted - it is recorded as single-skill detail belonging in that skill
both-states control: raising min_skills_for_promotion above the top candidate's count empties the promotion set, proving the threshold is live
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the dedupe-auditor, cross-vendor, which checks the clusters are not already rules
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8302 emitted only when every candidate carries a distinct-skill count with per-skill anchors; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8302 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then emit the raw caveat groups unclustered rather than forcing a cluster
work_unit.mechanism: semantic clustering with a distinct-SKILL count as the promotion threshold

stages.title: Single-skill detail belongs in its skill, not in a rule
S2 - prefer a SCRIPT: a rule competes for the always-on budget, a script does not

work_unit.title: Decide for each principle whether a script could enforce it mechanically
work_unit.question_or_target: For each candidate, decide whether the principle is decidable by an exact algorithm - counting, set membership, byte comparison, schema validation - and if so route it to a SCRIPT rather than to a rule.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: judging decidability requires knowing what a script could actually observe, which is the veto's whole content

work_unit.evidence_requirement: for each principle, the verdict script-enforceable or judgement-only, with the exact check a script would perform when enforceable
tests_required: a principle stating a countable property is routed to a SCRIPT and does not reach the rule proposal
a principle requiring judgement stays a rule candidate, so the veto is not rejecting every principle
the named script check is concrete enough to implement; 'a script could check this' with no check named is not a verdict
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the dedupe-auditor, which checks a script proposal does not duplicate an existing gate
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8303 emitted only when every candidate carries a script-enforceable verdict and, when enforceable, the concrete check; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8303 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then mark the principle judgement-only and record the undecided enforceability
work_unit.mechanism: script-first veto that removes mechanically-decidable principles from the rule surface

stages.title: An enforceable principle may not be proposed as a rule
S2b - emit a script specification for each enforceable principle

work_unit.title: Specify the script that enforces each mechanically-decidable principle
work_unit.question_or_target: Write an implementable specification per enforceable principle: the inputs it enumerates, the failure it emits, and the known-bad input that proves the gate can go red.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: a specification that cannot fail closed is a permanently green gate, so the spec author must reason about the empty-input case

work_unit.evidence_requirement: per script: the input enumeration, the fail-closed behaviour on an empty walk, the terminal marker it prints, and a named known-bad input
tests_required: each spec names a known-bad input that makes the gate exit non-zero - a gate that has never gone red is indistinguishable from a no-op
each spec fails CLOSED on an empty input walk rather than reporting nothing-found as a pass
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the dedupe-auditor, checking the script does not duplicate an existing gate
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8304 emitted only when every enforceable principle has a spec with a fail-closed rule and a known-bad input; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8304 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then downgrade the principle to judgement-only rather than shipping an unfalsifiable gate spec
work_unit.mechanism: script specification carrying its own fail-closed rule and a known-bad input
work_unit.not_a_duplicate_because: the enforceability audit DECIDES whether a script is possible; this writes the spec that makes it falsifiable, which is where a no-op gate would otherwise be born

stages.title: S3 - dedupe against the existing rules; distinguish NEW from NEEDS-UPDATE

work_unit.title: Refute any proposal that already exists as a rule, and separate updates from additions
work_unit.question_or_target: For each surviving principle, decide NEW, RESTATES-EXISTING or EXISTING-NEEDS-UPDATE by searching the rules tree, so the sweep cannot rediscover a rule it already wrote.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: the synthesiser that just clustered a principle is the least likely to notice it already exists

work_unit.evidence_requirement: for each RESTATES verdict, the existing rule file:line that already says it; for each NEEDS-UPDATE, the clause that is now wrong
tests_required: the dedupe control: a principle that already exists as a rule is caught and cited - if the sweep rediscovers an existing rule, the dedupe step is broken
an existing rule whose content is now WRONG is classified NEEDS-UPDATE, not as a new rule alongside the stale one
both-states control: a genuinely novel principle is classified NEW, so the auditor is not rejecting everything
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the cluster-synthesiser, which may contest a RESTATES verdict with a distinguishing mechanism
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8305 emitted only when every surviving principle carries one of the three verdicts with a citation where applicable; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8305 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then mark the principle CONTESTED and let the owner decide rather than double-adding
work_unit.mechanism: cross-vendor dedupe with a three-way NEW / RESTATES / NEEDS-UPDATE verdict

stages.title: A new rule must not restate an existing one
S3b - an existing rule that is now wrong is UPDATED, not duplicated

work_unit.title: Propose a correction to each existing rule the sweep found to be stale
work_unit.question_or_target: For each EXISTING-NEEDS-UPDATE verdict, propose the corrected clause and record what the old clause claimed, so the correction is traceable and the stale guidance is retired rather than silently overwritten.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: deciding what an updated clause should say is authoring work, not a mechanical patch

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the old clause verbatim, the proposed replacement, and the observation that made the old one wrong
tests_required: the old clause is recorded verbatim, so a corrected rule cannot be silently rewritten as though it was always right
a rule update does not increase the always-on line count unless the budget gate allows it
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: the dedupe-auditor, which verifies the update targets the rule it cited
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8306 emitted only when every NEEDS-UPDATE verdict has a proposed replacement plus the old clause recorded; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8306 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then propose the correction as a comment on the rule rather than a rewrite
work_unit.mechanism: in-place rule correction with the superseded clause recorded verbatim

stages.title: S4 - propose the surviving rules within the context budget

work_unit.title: Emit the rule proposals with their line cost and displacement plan
work_unit.question_or_target: Write the surviving rules with a measured line cost, and when the total would exceed rule_line_budget, name what each new rule DISPLACES rather than assuming the budget will stretch.

assigned_model_vendor_role.basis: choosing what to displace is a priority judgement the budget arithmetic cannot make

work_unit.evidence_requirement: the projected always-on line count after the change, and for an over-budget proposal the specific rule or clause it displaces
tests_required: an over-budget proposal names a displacement; it does not silently exceed rule_line_budget
a sweep that found no cross-cutting principle proposes NOTHING and says so, rather than promoting a single-skill detail to justify the run
work_unit.reviewer_requirement: one independent adversarial reviewer in a fresh context who recomputes the projected line count
work_unit.completion_sentinel: SUCCESS:DOC-8307 emitted only when the projected line count is recorded and any overage carries a named displacement; otherwise FAILED:DOC-8307 <reason>
work_unit.retry_policy: two strikes then propose the highest-value rule alone rather than the whole set
work_unit.mechanism: budget-aware rule proposal with an explicit displacement plan

stages.title: Rules compete for the always-on context budget

impact.blast_radius: proposal only: skills/** and rules/** are in forbid_write_paths, so the sweep cannot edit the corpus it is reading

worked_example.scenario: Run the sweep over a 60-skill vault after a batch of new skills landed.
expected_trace: scan-corpus -> 2 shards, 412 caveats with skill attribution; barrier quorum 1.0
cluster-principles -> 23 candidates; 14 appear in only ONE skill and are recorded as single-skill detail
check-script-enforceable -> 4 of the 9 remaining are decidable by an exact check (a path exists, a marker is present, a count matches) and are routed to SCRIPTS
script-first-gate PASS (0 enforceable principles proposed as rules)
emit-script-spec -> 4 specs, each naming a known-bad input that makes the gate exit non-zero
dedupe-against-existing -> of the 5 judgement-only principles: 2 NEW, 2 RESTATES-EXISTING (cited), 1 EXISTING-NEEDS-UPDATE
dedupe-gate PASS; update-existing-rule -> 1 correction with the old clause recorded verbatim
propose-rules -> 2 new rules costing 34 lines; projected total 286 <= 300; no displacement needed
worked_example.expected_terminal_state: SUCCESS:DOC-8307 with 2 rules proposed, 4 scripts specified and 2 restatements rejected

bp7.unverified: UNVERIFIED that the sweep does not rediscover rules it already wrote; the dedupe stage is the control and its own test is the settling experiment - run the sweep on an unchanged corpus and require it to propose ZERO new rules, because every candidate should classify as RESTATES-EXISTING on the second pass.

distinct_from.bp-doc-01: that captures from ONE branch; this scans the WHOLE corpus for cross-skill repetition
distinct_from.bp-doc-03: that reconciles one FACT stated in many places and ends in a pointer rewrite; this clusters many caveats into a new principle and can end in a SCRIPT instead of a document
distinct_from.BP-MNT-05: that inventories the portfolio; this reads the portfolio's content for repeated caveats

bp7.flagship_rationale: NOT flagship: its convergence property (a second pass over an unchanged corpus proposes zero new rules) requires a full skill vault and two sequential runs. The script-first veto ordering, the distinct-skill threshold and the displacement requirement ARE asserted by test_bp7_slice.py.
